x: The race was won by Linford (T.V.H.) for Lensbury in 2m.0.8s., on a five laps to the mile grass track. Dudley Gordon was unlucky not to win the 440, losing by inches, after leading all the way - he also doubled up in the 100yds.

Malcolm Robinson, our only entrant, found himself up against opponents such as Earl, Linford, Chapman and Ellis, but with his usual show of determination and ever-improving ability he secured a point with a time of 4m.2·4s., another best performance.
The first leg, an 880, was run by Dave Mitchell and he handed over to Alan Jackson some twenty yards behind Linford (T.V.H.) and Frank Wright, running for the Police.

As it turned out, three league records were broken; Linford in the 100 metres, Mike Edwards in the pole vault and Belgrave's team managers who made 26 team alterations through the afternoon as problem followed problem and team members mixed and matched events as part of a damage limitation exercise.
